senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. טוּר I)to guard, observe.
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 157:5">Sifré Num. 157</cite> (expl. <he>טירתם</he>, <cite ref="Numbers 31:10">Num. XXXI, 10</cite>) <he>מקום שהיו נוֹטְרִים ע״ז וכ׳</he> the place where they guarded their idols; Yalk. ib. 785 <he>שהיו נוטרין בית וכ׳</he> their idolatrous temple.
Yalk. Prov. 964 כשם שהתרנגול … ונוֹטֵר לבני אדם as the cock crows by night and holds guard for men; a. e.—Esp. (with ref. to Lev. XIX, 18) to reserve anger, bear grudge.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 55">Gen. R. s. 55</cite> <he>כתבת בתורתך … ואת נוקם ונוטר</he> thou hast written in thy Law (Lev. l. c.) thou shalt not &c., and thou takest revenge and reservest wrath (<cite ref="Nahum 1:2">Nah. I, 2</cite>)?; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 8:4">Koh. R. to VIII, 4</cite> <he>לא אֶטּוֹר</he> I will not reserve &c.
<cite ref="Yoma 23a">Yoma 23ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:12">Cant. R. to IV, 12</cite> <he>מנטרים</he>, read: <he>מנסכים</he>, v. <cite ref="N00946"><he>נָסַךְ</he></cite>.]
